reason: JSW Cement's commissioning of a 1 MTPA grinding unit in Nagaur increases its total capacity to 25.10 MTPA, enhancing its market share and revenue potential in North India.
why_now: The commissioning was confirmed in official filings on October 06, 2026.
source_headlines: JSW Cement Limited: Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, -Commissioning Of Additional 1 MTPA Grinding Unit At Nagaur.

JSW Cement Limited: We hereby enclose the Press Release titled JSW Cement Strengthens its Regional Capacity in North India Commissioning of Additional 1.00 MTPA Grinding Unit at Nagaur, Rajasthan takes the Company s total Installed grinding capacity to 25.10 MTPA regarding the successful commissioning of an additional 1.00 MTPA cement grinding unit at Nagaur, Rajasthan.
source_headline: JSW Cement Limited: Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, -Commissioning Of Additional 1 MTPA Grinding Unit At Nagaur.
